scope: Independent IHV protocol-33 state codecs, transactional server-message readers/writers and length-only demo containers. These components are not integrated into engine startup, client/server sessions or demo commands.
profile: Q3 IHV external contracts; no engine IHV profile is selected by these tests.
working_tree: Uncommitted IHV wire follow-up. Earlier IHV/Q3 release work and unrelated RTCW changes remain present.

reference.use: Read-only binary observations and direct calls of hash-pinned message functions. No original executable entry point, platform initialization, game windows, input or network sessions run in this probe.
reference.incorporation: No reference implementation, module, recording or asset incorporated. CI inputs are synthetic; fixtures are numeric results.

state_encoding.bits: LSB first, arbitrary bit alignment, no retail Huffman or keyed usercmd coding.
state_encoding.entity: 10-bit number, removal/changed bits, 50 ordered change-bit fields with byte/short/integer/float storage.
state_encoding.player: Grouped 16-bit mask with optional upper 16 bits, grouped scalar encodings and four masked arrays.
state_encoding.command: Eight-bit mask, changed short angles/byte movement/buttons/weapon, then unconditional duration byte.
state_encoding.untransmitted_storage: The independent codecs retain baseline padding and other untransmitted bytes. Original decoder comparisons initialize the destination from that baseline.

quirks: Entity writer compares new constantLight at offset 144 against the old loopSound BYTE at 148; reader uses the old constantLight field.
Player color group compares only byte 96 and, when changed, sends bytes 96..99.
x87 unordered float comparisons suppress a change; positive/negative zero compare equal. Float reads through x87 quiet signaling NaNs.
Angle scale is binary32 182.0444488525390625; _ftol truncates to signed int64 before the low 16 bits are retained. Nonfinite/out-of-int64 results have low 16 bits zero.
An unchanged entity delta copies its baseline including number zero; the original packet-entity reader discards a resulting number zero.
observations.server_commands: Opcode 5 plus string only; returned as data, never executed by the codec.
observations.outer_termination: Byte extent with zero unused bits, no retail svc_EOF byte.
observations.download_opcode: 6: explicitly UnsupportedDownload, without publishing partial state or writing files.
observations.demo_container: Signed little-endian length followed by message bytes, terminated by -1. No per-record message sequence word.

original_function_comparisons.input_generation: Every storage bit including padding, deterministic random states, special float pairs, entity-number boundaries, forced/omitted records, removal and observed quirks.

x64.result: PASS; no sanitizer diagnostics; supplied demo parse/regeneration and rejection also pass.

malformed_and_recovery: Bit widths, null/overflowing extents, arbitrary alignment, truncated state records and unchanged output on capacity failure.
Unknown player flags/opcodes, missing gamestate/delta, bad protocol/config index, duplicate entities/snapshots, area bounds, frame eviction and parse-entity age.
All byte truncations of representative gamestate/snapshot messages and demo containers; every bit mutation of three representative messages; 4096 deterministic random packets.
Message rollback preserves prior gamestate, history and caller output. Writer failures preserve prior command bytes and permit later valid appends.
Container lengths, absent terminators, trailing bytes, zero/oversized messages, write/finish capacity failure, repeated finish and overlapping input/output.

sli.difference: Each initial full snapshot contains unchanged records for absent baselines 47,65,66,73,74,75. They decode to number zero and are discarded, so canonical regeneration omits six 12-bit no-op records per snapshot.
sli.regenerated_file: In-memory test only; no proprietary recording committed.

berj.result: Malformed configstring-only block rejected before gamestate publication in both x86 and x64 tests.

commands.temporary_environment: TEMP and TMP set to E:/Repositories/fnTech3/.tmp/q3-ihv; commands run from E:/Repositories/fnTech3.
